userStories.notes: Added persistence to praxis/reports/digest_html.py: write_digest(digest, home=None) -> Path renders the digest and writes weeks/<iso>.html atomically (temp file + os.replace, no leftover .tmp on success), then refreshes latest.html via _update_latest_pointer (relative symlink on POSIX; copy fallback when symlink_to raises OSError/NotImplementedError - covers Windows-without-developer-mode and FAT filesystems). Home directory defaults via the existing PRAXIS_HOME pattern (praxis.storage.profile_store.resolve_home), so tests sandbox via tmp_path or monkeypatch.setenv. Acceptance criteria all locked in by tests/test_digest_html.py: path layout (weeks/<iso>.html), weeks-dir auto-create, latest.html exists and dereferences to the same bytes, relative-symlink target (resilient to ~/.praxis being moved), overwrite-same-week behavior, broken-symlink replacement, no leftover .tmp, and PRAXIS_HOME-honoring default. 745 tests pass (was 732 + 13 new for US-064); pyright clean on praxis/reports/digest_html.py and tests/test_digest_html.py.

userStories.title: No raw secrets, synthetic markers, or obvious PII in output
acceptanceCriteria: No `<synthetic>` strings appear anywhere in the rendered HTML
No unredacted provider API keys appear (verified against the secret-redaction patterns)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Wired praxis.redactor.redact_secrets and a <synthetic> marker strip into the render path of praxis/reports/digest_html.py. New private helper _safe(text) replaces every prior html.escape call on user-content fields: it runs redact_secrets first (so provider API keys / AWS access keys / GitHub PATs / JWTs / labeled-secret tails become [REDACTED]), strips the literal <synthetic> placeholder used by the codex scanner's _real_model path, then html.escapes the result. Order matters: redact and strip BEFORE escape, so `<synthetic>` never even reaches the <synthetic> visible-but-still-leaked form. The redactor is itself idempotent and .replace is too, so _safe is idempotent. Applied to: week_iso, generated_at, Trajectory(label/headline/confidence_band), MomentPanel(quoted_excerpt/why_lost_score/next_time_try), CostLedger(biggest_line/sonnet_swap_note), TaskRow.label, DimRow.title, FollowUpPanel(commitment_text/outcome), one_thing_to_try. Added 14 tests under 'US-065: no synthetic markers, no raw secrets, no PII' covering: each provider key family is redacted, every user-content field path is sealed, surrounding prose is preserved, idempotence under double-render, on-disk write_digest output is clean, US-061 self-containment is preserved, existing html.escape behavior for non-synthetic angle brackets still holds, and an already-[REDACTED] placeholder is not re-redacted. 759 tests pass (was 745 + 14 new); pyright clean on praxis/reports/digest_html.py and tests/test_digest_html.py.
